name: Draw Topology (COMPAS CEM)
description: Draw a topology diagram in color, with deviation edges dashed, loaded nodes crossed and the keys as optional labels.

inputParameters.name: node_keys
inputParameters.description: A selection of the node keys in the diagram, which also selects the load crosses drawn. Defaults to all the node keys.

inputParameters.name: edge_keys
inputParameters.description: A selection of the edge keys in the diagram. Defaults to all the edge keys.

inputParameters.name: show_labels
inputParameters.description: Whether to label the drawn nodes with their keys and the drawn edges with u-v in the viewport. The labels do not bake. Defaults to False.

outputParameters.name: nodes
outputParameters.description: The nodes in the diagram as points: green at a support, purple at an origin, white otherwise. Bakes with their colors.

outputParameters.name: origin_nodes
outputParameters.description: The origin nodes in the diagram as purple points. Bakes with their colors.

outputParameters.name: support_nodes
outputParameters.description: The support nodes in the diagram as green points. Bakes with their colors.

outputParameters.name: edges
outputParameters.description: The edges in the diagram as lines, blue in compression and red in tension by their length or force, orange on an auxiliary trail; deviation edges show dashed. Bakes as solid lines with their colors and plot weights.

outputParameters.name: trail_edges
outputParameters.description: The trail edges in the diagram as lines, colored as in edges. Bakes with their colors and plot weights.

outputParameters.name: deviation_edges
outputParameters.description: The deviation edges in the diagram as lines, colored as in edges. Bakes as solid lines with their colors and plot weights.

outputParameters.name: trails
outputParameters.description: The trails in the diagram as pink polylines, orange for an auxiliary trail. Bakes with their colors and plot weights.

outputParameters.name: loads
outputParameters.description: A black cross at every loaded node, as two lines each in the XY plane. Bakes with their colors and plot weights.
